title: A flat map of locally Noetherian spaces from a Cohen-Macaulay source is Cohen-Macaulay with CM target local rings
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms of Spaces)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file spaces-more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: For a flat morphism f : X -> Y of locally Noetherian algebraic spaces over S with X Cohen-Macaulay, the morphism f is Cohen-Macaulay and every local ring O_{Y,f(x)} is Cohen-Macaulay. The retained proof states the mechanism: after translating into algebra using the chapter's lemma-CM (and comparing with the proof of lemma-composition-CM) the claim is Algebra, lemma-CM-goes-up. Retained author proof at lines 6360-6365.
